hints.title: Last Even Digit Location
hints.text: An integer is even if and only if its last digit is even.

hints.title: Scan from Right to Left
hints.text: Scan the string backwards from the last character to find the first even digit.

hints.title: Truncate Suffix
hints.text: Return the prefix ending at that last even digit index.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Linear time and constant extra memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects clean reverse scan and substring extraction.
